build_make_rnn: build an RNN model with make_rnn that takes a haiku RNN core and returns a callable model function
create_rnn_lstm: create an LSTM-based RNN model using make_rnn with hk.LSTM and a specified output size
run_rnn_sequence: run the RNN model on a sequence tensor and return the last output with a linear projection
create_rnn_all_outputs: create an RNN model that returns all time-step outputs instead of only the last one
build_rnn_windowed: build an RNN model with input_window to process multiple tokens at once per time step
